title: Multi-bug Go debugging session — 4 turns
description: Three bugs: data race, nil deref, logic error. Each fixed in separate turn, then race detector run.

task_spec.prompt: Fix the data race in `bugs.go`: implement `SafeCounter.Increment()` — lock `c.mu`, increment `c.value`, unlock. Implement `SafeCounter.Value()` — lock `c.mu`, read `c.value`, unlock. Run `go test -race ./...` to verify no data races in TestSafeCounterConcurrent.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what you fixed. Now fix `FindFirst`: the bug is that it returns `&item` which is a pointer to the loop variable — instead, copy the value: `copy := item; return &copy`. Run `go test ./...`.
Good. Now fix Bug 3 in `SumPositive`: add `if n > 0` guard before `total += n`. Run `go test ./...` and fix any failures.
Final push: run `go test -race ./...` and confirm a completely clean build — no data races and all 5 tests pass.
success_criteria: SafeCounter uses mutex for thread-safe increment and read
FindFirst returns copy of match, not pointer to loop var
go test -race ./... shows no data races and all 5 tests pass
